text_read: digest only (Way of Initiation and Initiation and Its Results)
mode_evidence: The luminous cloud and flame around a physical seed are said to be perceived by 'spiritualized vision' with 'spiritual eyes', 'colors of a spiritual kind which are discerned', not by the physical eye. He anticipates the objection 'what is the value of such visions or hallucinations?' and insists they differ from phantasy, but gives no account of where in the visual field they are located.
onset_evidence: An explicit method for a beginner: contemplate crystal, plant and animal with set thoughts and feeling; then a real seed with the thought that the invisible plant force lies in it, felt intensely. 'Possibly not until after numerous attempts' an inward force makes itself felt and the seed appears in a small luminous cloud. Patience, moral development, reverence and health are prerequisites; an experienced guide is advised beyond this point; the fire of Kundalini 'may only form the subject of actual occult training'.

conditions.gaze_or_eye_position: observe the object with fixed attention
conditions.setting: calmness of mind, free of disturbing influence
conditions.duration_and_schedule: repeated over many attempts; each thought given time to become embedded in the soul
conditions.prerequisites: probation exercises of reverence; moral strength and inner purity; healthy sober judgment; a guide for further steps
conditions.other: no other thoughts or emotions to be mixed in

stages.label: seed in a luminous cloud
stages.description: The seed appears enclosed in a small luminous cloud perceived as a flame, lilac at the centre, blue at the edges.

stages.label: mature plant
stages.description: After the withering-and-seed exercise, a larger flame, greenish at the centre and tinged with yellow at the outer edge.

stages.label: lotus organs lucent
stages.description: In the sequel the astral lotus-flowers first become lucent and later revolve; clairvoyance begins then.

what_to_do_with_light: Do not luxuriate in it; keep a clear head and conscious control, and repeat for the subsequent plant exercise.
obstacles_and_fixes: Probably the experiment fails at first: repeat with patience
Doubt that the flame is mere illusion: keep distinguishing reality from phantasy with sober self-examination
Emotions fade with the object: practise until they arise without it
cautions: Never surrender fully conscious control of oneself; avoid reveries
Do not go beyond the elementary stage without an experienced guide
Experimenting in the dark is strongly discouraged by true occultism
Steiner says crystal-gazing is a distortion of the true contemplation of crystals
interpretation: Spiritual colours and flames are the invisible forces of life and form behind objects, perceived by spiritual eyes (organs formed by cultivated feeling and thought).
practice_summary: First cultivate reverence and moral steadiness. Then contemplate a transparent crystal, a plant and an animal with fixed attention and set thoughts, until distinct feelings arise from each and later arise without the object. Next place a real seed before you and think intensely, in calm, that the invisible future plant lies in it, feeling that thought deeply. Repeat. Possibly only after numerous attempts, the seed appears wrapped in a small luminous cloud, a flame lilac at the centre and blue at the edge. Follow with a full-grown plant and the thought of its decay and seeds, giving a greenish flame tinged yellow. Keep sober control throughout and seek a guide for further steps.
